title: Bottle Listing From One Photo
tests: Tests turning one attached product photo into three finished listing images while preserving the source product's identity.

faults.what: The supposed lid-detail image repeats the original full-bottle photo rather than providing a close-up of the lid and matte surface.
The white-background version makes the bottle and lid noticeably glossier, with strong reflective highlights that do not preserve the original matte finish.

judge.summary: Three separate square images were delivered, but the detail shot is unchanged from the original and the white-background bottle looks too glossy.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a collage.
must_haves.why: All three outputs are separate square images.

must_haves.item: The bottle in every image matches the attached photo's silhouette, proportions, lid and matte black finish.
must_haves.why: The overall bottle shape and lid are closely retained, but the white-background version has a noticeably shinier finish than the source.

must_haves.item: The white-background image shows the entire bottle with the original wooden table removed.
must_haves.why: The complete bottle is visible against white, with the wooden table removed.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the bottle convincingly on a gym bench.
must_haves.why: The bottle sits plausibly on a padded gym bench with a credible contact shadow and gym equipment in the background.

must_haves.item: The close-up clearly shows the lid and matte surface without inventing new product features.
must_haves.why: The third output is the original full-bottle composition, not a close-up; the lid and finish receive no additional detail.

must_haves.item: No added text or branding appears.
must_haves.why: No visible text or branding has been added.
